prompt: In a photorealistic photo of a sunlit pottery workshop, a woman in a blue apron sits at the center wheel, shaping wet clay with focused hands. To her left, an elderly man in a grey vest stands watching intently, his arms crossed over his chest. On the right, a young boy in a striped shirt points eagerly at a tall vase drying on a wooden shelf nearby. A small orange cat sleeps peacefully on a stack of towels behind the woman, curled into a tight ball. Next to the boy, a green watering can rests on the floor, its spout angled toward the wall. The woman looks at the elderly man while smoothing the rim of her pot. The boy interacts with the scene by gesturing toward the finished ceramic piece. There is no electric kiln visible in the background.
